gatesMeaning: Conservative screening limits, fixed before full cohorts complete; not statistical proof or permission to tune other rules.

definitions.B2: verified actual local forces; one attacker cannot damage or devastate; pressure capped at 1.5; zero local attackers ends contact
definitions.C2: B2 plus exclude up to two verified local unassigned capital residents from recruitment; no garrison immobility or return order
definitions.B3v2: B2 with fixed maximum three real formation members
definitions.episodes: city contact episodes, not independent campaigns or credited defensive victories; completed episodes exclude right-censored ongoing contacts
definitions.forces: attacker:defender:currentWall:maxWall settlement samples; repeated callbacks are not troops
definitions.retakes: actual capture or revolt within full observed follow-up window
definitions.pressureDamage: controlled Core scenarios measure force effect directly; aggregate wall delta excludes final breach when capture restores walls
definitions.capital: actual locally verified population, never national reserves
definitions.limits: same initial seeds; after simulation changes RNG and history can diverge; no screenshots or visual acceptance
